items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: And then it was around the end of 38 and Wingy sent for me.

ctx.x: the record with them. But I don't know. Well tell me about John and Wingy. Did you leave from here to John and Wingy or what? How did that work? Yeah, I'd come home. Well I'd been

home, let's see, well I came home in 36, you see, and I played with Curse for a while. And then it was around the end of 38 and Wingy sent for me. And I got to know Ray Benitez around here, we used to hang around together at night and time. And Wingy sent for both of us. And Ray was tickled to death because he wanted to get to New York, but he didn't have a New York car and he thought he could get in, but he couldn't make it, couldn't get in. For me they said they sent him back? No, he stayed up there for a…
Well he probably played a few spots out there. No, Ray probably played some job, I don't
